nodes.name: Respond.io Trigger
nodes.notes: New Outgoing Message, with Event Source restricted to 'user' so only a team member's own message advances the ticket -- bot, AI Agent, workflow, Zapier/Make/n8n and Developer API sends are excluded at the source. Message Type is left empty, which means every type.

nodes.name: Normalize for SIMS
nodes.notes: Maps the Respond.io payload onto the field names POST /api/integrations/respond-io reads, and normalizes the message direction for the next node.

nodes.name: Agent message?
nodes.notes: Second line of defence behind the trigger's Event Source = User filter. Passes outgoing and unknown-direction messages; drops a definite 'incoming'. Deliberately not 'equals outgoing': if a payload change stops sending the direction field the workflow degrades to the trigger's own guarantee rather than dropping every event. The false branch is intentionally unconnected.

nodes.name: POST SIMS webhook
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name 'x-sims-webhook-secret', value = the secret issued in General > Integrations. Retries 3x, which is safe: the SIMS event ledger absorbs redelivery, and a ticket already In Progress returns noop.
